role: Analyzes D-14's incident status transition map for logic-loop deadlocks via a real graph cycle-detection algorithm — confirms no cycle exists, a legitimate negative finding, not a lesser result than an attack that succeeds.
behaviorDescription: analyzeStateGraph() runs a real DFS-based cycle-detection algorithm against D-14's actual, live ALLOWED_FROM transition map (open/investigating/resolved) — confirmed to be a genuine DAG with 'resolved' as a true terminal state, no logic-loop deadlock possible. This has ongoing regression value: if the transition map is ever edited to accidentally introduce a cycle, this same analysis catches it. attemptConcurrentRace() is an honest stub: it throws a clear error, because verifying real concurrent-transaction race behavior against D-14's SQL-level guard requires a live Postgres connection under genuine concurrent load, which this sandbox does not have.
hardStops: Never signals or persists through the production swarmSignalBus or bot_decisions table — isolated via RedTeamBot
Never claims to have tested concurrent-transaction race safety — attemptConcurrentRace() throws until a live Postgres connection is available to verify against
